description: Pushes a trained model to a Hugging Face Hub model repo (created if it doesn't exist) and returns its links. Wire Model Training's model output (YOLO weights/best.pt, or a HuggingFace best_model folder) and, optionally, its metrics output for a model card. The links are in the result output's hf_upload.json: repo_url, and download_url pinned to this upload. Needs a team secret holding a Hugging Face token with WRITE access.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The trained model: Model Training's model output.

inputs.name: metrics
inputs.description: Optional: Model Training's metrics output. Uploaded as metrics.json and summarized in the model card.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The repo's links: repo_url, download_url (pinned to this upload's commit), and one link per uploaded file.

repo_id.description: Model repo to push to: 'user-or-org/name', or just 'name' to use the token's own account. Created if it doesn't exist.

hf_token.description: Team secret holding a Hugging Face access token with WRITE access (huggingface.co/settings/tokens). Passed to the job as HF_TOKEN.

private.description: Create the repo as private. Only applies when the repo is created; an existing repo keeps its visibility. Links to a private repo need a token to open.

skip_model_card.description: Don't write a README.md model card (task, base model, metrics, usage). Turn on to keep a card you edited on the Hub.

exec_queue.description: Scheduler queue. This is a CPU-only job, so it defaults to a CPU queue (overrides the run-level queue).

tapis_job.name: hf-model-upload
tapis_job.description: Push a trained model to the Hugging Face Hub

appArgs.name: tool
appArgs.description: The shared wf-utils container runs several small tools; this picks which one (jobs/wf_utils/).

appArgs.name: model
appArgs.description: --source_name restores the weights' own file name (best.pt): the staged copy is just input/model.
